title: 간판 읽기 1: 편의점·약국·병원·은행
objective: Read 편의점, 약국, 병원 and 은행 aloud with the right sound changes, and find places by their signs.
summary: Read four common Korean street signs with natural pronunciation.

task.title: Read and use signs
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then write your answer for each part.

words.exampleMeaning: I buy water at the convenience store.
There is a pharmacy over there.
I'm going to see a doctor today.
What time does the bank open?

letters.as: Before a syllable starting with silent ㅇ, the final consonant moves on to the next vowel, like 'pyeo-ni'. A final ㅇ (ng) does not move: 공원 [공원].
After final ㄱ or ㅂ, a following ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅅ or ㅈ becomes tense: 'kk', 'tt', 'pp', 'ss', 'jj' (식당 [식땅], 책방 [책빵]).
Say 의 as 'ui' at the start of a word, otherwise often just 'i'. (의원 = clinic, a small doctor's office; on signs it often follows the type of doctor, e.g. 내과의원 = internal medicine clinic.)

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 약국 ② 편의점 ③ 병원
Does the final consonant move to the next syllable? Write Yes or No: ① 단어 ② 공원 ③ 금요일
How do you usually say 의 in each word, [의] or [이]? ① 의원 ② 편의점 ③ 내과의원
Read each sign. Write in English what kind of place it is: ① 미소약국 ② 한강은행 ③ 사랑내과의원
Fill in the blank with 편의점, 병원 or 은행: ① 배가 아파요. ____에 가요. ② 돈을 찾아요. ____에 가요. ③ 밤에 우유를 사요. ____에 가요.
answers: ① Yes [다너] ② No [공원] ③ Yes [그묘일]
① pharmacy ② bank ③ clinic (doctor's office)
① 병원 ② 은행 ③ 편의점
